001package iscteiul.ista.battleship;
002
003import java.util.List;
004
005/**
006 * Defines firing, shot statistics and board display for a game against a fleet.
007 */
008public interface IGame {
009    /**
010     * Fires at a position and updates the corresponding shot statistics.
011     * Invalid or repeated shots do not damage ships or enter the shot history.
012     *
013     * @param pos the non-null target position
014     * @return the ship sunk by this shot, or {@code null} for a miss, an invalid
015     *         or repeated shot, or a hit that does not sink a ship
016     */
017    IShip fire(IPosition pos);
018
019    /**
020     * Returns the history of valid, non-repeated shots.
021     *
022     * @return the game's mutable shot list in firing order
023     */
024    List<IPosition> getShots();
025
026    /**
027     * Returns the number of shots at previously targeted valid positions.
028     *
029     * @return the repeated shot count
030     */
031    int getRepeatedShots();
032
033    /**
034     * Returns the number of shots rejected by the game's coordinate validation.
035     *
036     * @return the invalid shot count
037     */
038    int getInvalidShots();
039
040    /**
041     * Returns the number of valid, non-repeated shots that hit ships.
042     *
043     * @return the hit count
044     */
045    int getHits();
046
047    /**
048     * Returns the number of ships sunk by shots during this game.
049     *
050     * @return the sunk ship count
051     */
052    int getSunkShips();
053
054    /**
055     * Returns the number of ships in the fleet that remain afloat.
056     *
057     * @return the remaining ship count
058     */
059    int getRemainingShips();
060
061    /** Prints the board with recorded valid shots marked by {@code X}. */
062    void printValidShots();
063
064    /** Prints the board with all ship positions marked by {@code #}. */
065    void printFleet();
066}
